notes.title: The Way Home UI and Challenge Update
notes.content:
Dive into an enhanced gaming experience with the latest update for "The Way Home"! We've completely revamped the user interface to deliver a more inviting and user-friendly atmosphere, ensuring every player feels right at home in our immersive world.

Embark on a thrilling journey with the introduction of Challenge Mode! Test your skills with words of varying difficulties—easy, medium, and hard—bringing a new layer of excitement to your gameplay. Sharpen your wit and conquer the challenges that await, as you navigate through a visually stunning environment made even more engaging with our UI makeover.

Get ready for an unforgettable adventure; update now and let the words guide you on "The Way Home"! 🚀

notes.title: Visual update
notes.content:
Update!

The letters light up a bit when you hit the right one.

Removed the keyboard from all but the easiest difficulty. Will make it an option at a later date.

Initial speed also slightly changed.

Stay tuned for more updates!
